module_summary: Source half of a 2-phase CDC FIFO: writes input words into a local register array, sends the write pointer and receives the read pointer through 2-phase CDC links, deriving full.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source data word written into the FIFO array.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; with ready forms the FIFO write.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Not-full ready from comparing write and synchronized read pointers.

anchors.name: fifo_data_q
anchors.why: FIFO word array written in source domain, read asynchronously by destination.

anchors.name: src_wptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer incremented per write, indexes array and sent across CDC.

anchors.name: src_rptr
anchors.why: Read pointer received via 2-phase CDC for full detection.

anchors.name: fifo_write
anchors.why: Write enable for array word and pointer increment.

anchors.name: fifo_widx
anchors.why: Low pointer bits selecting the array word written.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Whole FIFO array exported to destination domain.

anchors.name: async_wptr_data_o
anchors.why: Write pointer value sent to destination domain.

anchors.name: async_rptr_data_i
anchors.why: Read pointer value arriving from destination domain.

anchors.name: async_rptr_req_i
anchors.why: 2-phase request signalling a new read pointer.

groups.name: FIFO storage and write control
groups.description: Register array written at write pointer index on each accepted beat.

groups.name: Full detection
groups.description: Compares write and synchronized read pointers to derive ready.

groups.name: Write pointer CDC source
groups.description: 2-phase CDC source sending write pointer to destination.
